        squares.append((row, col))
squares.sort()
print(f"Current squares: {squares}")

# Let me check the last transition
if last_transition:
    before_squares = []
    for n in last_transition.before_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'S':
            row, col = n['boundary'][0]
            before_squares.append((row, col))
    before_squares.sort()
    print(f"Before squares: {before_squares}")
    
    after_squares = []
    for n in last_transition.after_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'S':
            row, col = n['boundary'][0]
            after_squares.append((row, col))
    after_squares.sort()
    print(f"After squares: {after_squares}")

# Let me check all transitions to understand the action model
print("\nAll transitions:")
for i, t in enumerate(transitions):
    before_squares = []
    for n in t.before_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'S':
            row, col = n['boundary'][0]
            before_squares.append((row, col))
    before_squares.sort()
    
    after_squares = []
    for n in t.after_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'S':
            row, col = n['boundary'][0]
            after_squares.append((row, col))
    after_squares.sort()
    
    if before_squares != after_squares:
        print(f"  {i}: {t.action} {before_squares} -> {after_squares}")

result = action(['SPACE'])

</function>
